title: Đại Học Đừng Học Đại: 4M+ Member Reach
client: Đại Học Đừng Học Đại & Đi Làm Đừng Đi Làm
summary: Co-founded and scaled two education and career communities to approximately 3M and 1M members within 12 months.
description:
Co-founded Đại Học Đừng Học Đại and Đi Làm Đừng Đi Làm, two education and career communities built for students and early-career professionals.

Scaled the communities to approximately 3M and 1M members respectively within 12 months through content strategy, community positioning, and consistent audience development.

Help students and early-career professionals identify suitable schools, academic majors, and long-term career directions aligned with their interests.
